capabilities: Generate a Gap Report note from the vault's link graph, word counts and frontmatter
Detect unexplained link pairs that no short bridging note connects
Detect stub hubs: heavily linked notes with very little text
Detect decisions marked in frontmatter or by tag that lack a stated rationale
Add semantic evidence passages and latent-topic sections with the optional Pro engine
disambiguation: Not a linter and not a to-do generator; the report is explicitly a set of structural prompts, not findings or tasks.
extras: Freemium: the three structural heuristics are free and work offline and on mobile; Pro sections require a one-time key and a separately downloaded local semantic engine. The README warns the engine is installed outside the vault, is the only reason the add-on reads and writes files outside the vault, and its report heuristics 'will be wrong more often than they are right' early on.
problem: Obsidian does not surface structural gaps where the link graph implies a note you never wrote, so these gaps stay invisible until you stumble on them.

relations.evidence: The engine is a separate program (embed-sidecar), published in the open at second-read-engine.
One key unlocks Pro in all five Second Read add-ons (Note Decay, Standing Questions, Effort Index, Prior Art, Unwritten).
relations.plugin: Note Decay, Standing Questions, Effort Index, Prior Art

requires.name: Second Read Pro license key ($29 one-time, for the Evidence and Latent topics report sections)

summary: Link-graph analyzer that writes a Gap Report note listing unexplained link pairs, stub hubs, and decisions with no stated reason.
